description: Bacterial infection (Brucella) causing reproductive failure, abortion, and chronic illness in cattle and buffalo. Zoonotic: humans can contract it from aborted materials, raw milk, and infected animals. Control relies on testing, culling, and vaccination programs.
symptoms: weight loss and poor body condition
first_aid: Handle aborted materials and placenta only with gloves; bury or dispose as directed by a veterinarian.
Isolate aborted animals and separate their milk; do not consume raw milk from suspect animals.
Avoid assisting calving without protection when reproductive disease is suspected in the herd.
Record abortion dates and animal IDs for veterinary testing and herd screening.
Contact a veterinarian for blood testing and official control measures; do not treat alone with antibiotics without diagnosis.
